data.cultural_impact: The name Matti carries a significant cultural impact, especially within the Christian community. It is derived from biblical names such as Matthias and Matthew, who are both notable figures in the New Testament. Matthias was one of the apostles chosen to replace Judas Iscariot, while Matthew was a tax collector whom Jesus called to become a disciple. The name Matti thus symbolizes the transformative power of faith, as it was given to individuals who were chosen or called by God, and went on to become influential figures in Christian history.

Additionally, the name Matti can serve as a reminder of the ultimate gift of salvation and eternal life that God offers to us through His Son, Jesus Christ.
